key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which part of the top bar holds the indicator: left, center or right.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: 0 is the first item in the section, higher values move the indicator further right.

key.name: notify-thresholds
key.description: Percentages that trigger a system notification when a device battery drops to or below them. An empty list turns the notifications off.

key.name: hidden-devices
key.description: Bluetooth addresses of devices that are not shown in the panel and do not send low battery notifications.
